# Boomline

> Boomline is purpose-built crane rental software — dispatch, equipment, inspections, certifications, and field operations for crane companies. Built with trusted field experts, for crane companies. On iOS, Android, and the web.

Generic field-service software wasn't built for crane rental. It doesn't properly cover the complexity of the scheduling, operations, and maintenance behind the scenes of a crane rental company. Boomline is built from the ground up for crane companies. Start small or run the full platform — we flip features on as you grow.

## Pages

- [Home](https://boomline.co/): The operating system for crane rental.
- [Features](https://boomline.co/features): Everything from dispatch to the back office.
- [About](https://boomline.co/about): Software written by people who actually run cranes. Founded by Matt Sullivan (co-founder, technology) and Jason O'Donnell (co-founder, crane operations).

## Operations

- Daily Dispatch: One board for the whole day. See who's available, assigned, or off — then push the dispatch to every employee and outside trucking partner at once.
- Jobs: Calendar and list views. Multi-day jobs, multi-crane jobs, job-site notes — all linked to a customer record.
- Unscheduled Jobs: The pipeline of work that isn't on the calendar yet. Quote it, schedule it, lose nothing.
- Quotes: Build quotes from rate tables. Convert to jobs in one step. Send PDF to customer.
- Job-site Logistics: Address, contact, lift specs, access notes. Everything the operator needs before showing up.
- Field Tickets (beta): Live digital job tickets, first and second signatures captured, linked to the job for billing. Exportable customer copy.
- TimeSheets: Weekly grid by employee. Standard time and overtime by job. Export to PDF.
- Time Off: Request, approve, balance-track. Visible on the dispatch board so you don't double-book.
- Safety & Training: Keep employees up to date with company safety standards.

## Equipment

- Cranes: Full asset record per machine. Hours, miles, inspections, maintenance log, work order history.
- Maintenance Command Center: Recurring service intervals by hours, miles, or calendar days. Overdue / Due soon / On track.
- Work Orders: Field, shop, or maintenance work orders, filtered by priority and assignable to techs or employees.
- Other Assets: Trucks, trailers, forklifts, and more — tracked alongside cranes.
- Outside Trucking and Employees: Track third-party trucking and outside employees on your managed jobs.
- Re-Rent Tracking: When you sub work out or rent machines. Cost, duration, customer billing — all reconciled.
- Inspections: Daily and monthly, tracked in the field and converted to a PDF document.
- Certifications: Medical cards, training records, and certifications. Stay updated before anything expires.

## Billing (beta)

- Billing (beta): Hourly, daily, or project-based. Standby, overtime, travel, mileage — all built in.
- Invoicing (beta): Generate from job data. Email to customer. Track sent / paid.

## Insights

- Equipment ROI: Jobs-per-crane, this quarter vs last.
- Customer Concentration: Top customers by revenue and amount of jobs.
- Maintenance Risk: Overdue maintenance exposure and inspection gaps.
- Notifications: Inspections expiring, certs lapsing, jobs unassigned — the right alert, to the right person.
- AI Business Analyst (optional): Ask questions about your data and get answers in clear, direct language.
- Voice AI (optional): Update jobs, dispatch crews, or log a note out loud.
